title: Boston 311: Will This Request Miss Its Deadline?
summary: Predicts, at submission time, whether a Boston 311 service request will miss the City's own SLA deadline, using a strict train-on-2025 / test-on-2026 split, explicit censoring and leakage checks, and honest baselines.
headline: On 137,225 requests from January to June 2026, gradient boosting reached ROC-AUC 0.8934 (vs 0.8667 for a per-type late-rate baseline), and 90.3% of the 10% highest-risk requests it flagged really did miss their SLA (vs 81.2% for the baseline).
